exact_missing_items: Add execution_role to effective-resolution record, attempt_record, tier_runtime_record or successor, and usage_record
Add operational-identity blocks to runtime records where side-effectful or externally-scoped actions matter
Operational identity kinds: github_api_account, registry_namespace, kubernetes_context
Ensure GUI inspectors can show requested/effective provider/account identity, requested/effective operational identity, execution role, and selection/switch reason
Make execution_role part of the canonical attempt packet in Contracts_V0.md and storage-plan.md
Define operational_identity as a separate optional field family for receipts, artifacts, and side-effect-bearing attempt/tool records
execution_role and operational_identity solve different problems and should not be merged
Multi-Account.md still has no durable account.switched / switch-episode family
provider_accounts.run_snapshot still stores only an opaque policy_hash rather than a queryable policy version/ref
no canonical role enum or actor_kind / execution_role field exists to support role-by-provider and role-by-account overrides consistently across docs

Orchestrator Progress widget layout decision: app-default with project override — this must be the single authoritative decision documented in Widget_System.md and cross-referenced from Orchestrator_Page.md
do-not-forget: run.started MUST field list in storage-plan.md still disagrees with the surrounding prose about how much identity to include
do-not-forget: provider_accounts.run_snapshot policy_hash should be a policy_version_ref for downstream policy-validity queries

account_switch_event record family must be append-only and carry: old_effective_account_id, new_effective_account_id, switch_reason, scope (run/lane/session), old_account_pressure_level, new_account_pressure_level
account_pressure_episode record family must carry: account_id, pressure_kind, start_utc, end_utc?, peak_pressure_level, contributing_switch_event_refs[]
both families must be queryable from History, Ledger, and Usage Pressure projections

do-not-forget: run.started MUST field list in storage-plan.md must agree with the operational_identity block definition — the event row must include the full operational_identity snapshot inline or by normative reference
do-not-forget: provider_accounts.run_snapshot policy_hash must become policy_version_ref to support downstream policy-validity queries
do-not-forget: usage_event_ref as structured locator must be defined before any surface ships Show in Usage or Show in Ledger pivots
